selection_rule: Choose SUBJECT_ORIGIN_MODE first. ARCHIVE_ARTIFACT families preserve real historical provenance. SPECULATIVE_OBJECT families require one hypothetical function, one complete morphology specification, and 2–4 purpose-bearing parts. Each compatible_morphologies list recommends catalog archetypes; CUSTOM_COMPOSED remains available to every speculative family when a content-derived form fits better. ABSTRACT_FORM uses the separate abstract-form deck and never selects an object family.

object_families.name: Retro signal instrument
object_families.function_requirement: state one signal-reading, receiving, tuning, or monitoring function before rendering
identity_anchors: one control surface
one signal aperture or dial
one antenna, cable, or side seam
object_families.material: colored molded shell, translucent indicator or convex glass dial, and one restrained warm-metal trim ring
object_families.geometry: one compact inflated or pod-like instrument body with a convex aperture or dial and one integrated antenna, cable, or flowing side seam
object_families.lighting: soft side light with readable tonal rolloff; no specular product highlight or black space
object_families.visual_behavior: front-facing or three-quarter crop; one readable interface-like form without invented text

object_families.name: Future utility device
object_families.function_requirement: state one portable maintenance, illumination, storage, calibration, or field-work function before rendering
identity_anchors: one handle or grip
one seam or hinge
one functional opening or status window
object_families.material: colored enamel, molded fiberglass, or translucent resin body with one warm-metal seam or trim detail and controlled soft shadow
object_families.geometry: one useful apparatus grown from a bubble, teardrop, or inflated shell, with an integrated grip, seam, and rounded functional opening or status window
object_families.lighting: broad diffuse directional shading with one active-hue plane; no hard neon glow or contemporary studio strip light
placements: floating on a long title axis
object_families.visual_behavior: one rounded, exaggerated object whose practical parts grow from the dominant curve; never a present-day appliance with softened corners

object_families.name: Kinetic mechanism
object_families.function_requirement: state one mechanical transfer, rotation, alignment, or movement function before rendering
identity_anchors: one circular or pivot point
one directional arm or belt
one cropped mechanical edge
object_families.material: flat powder-coated or translucent composite pieces with one active-hue emphasis
object_families.geometry: one pivot, arm, wheel, rotor, belt, or joint fragment with a clear directional axis
object_families.lighting: flat-to-soft directional shading that reveals the pivot and motion edge without metallic gloss
object_families.visual_behavior: show one moment of motion through crop and axis, not a technical diagram

object_families.name: Transit or architecture fragment
object_families.function_requirement: state one passage, docking, signaling, shelter, or routing function before rendering
identity_anchors: one threshold or frame
one receding edge
one signal or opening
object_families.material: soft architectural plane, tinted translucent panel, diffuse atmospheric depth
object_families.geometry: one rounded threshold, inflated frame, oval window band, tapered platform edge, or pod-like signal housing with a receding curve
object_families.lighting: soft plane-to-plane depth with atmospheric fade; no cinematic corridor light
object_families.visual_behavior: partial structure with a clear spatial direction and one soft aerodynamic or vertical silhouette; avoid glass-box modernism and complete sci-fi scenes

object_families.name: Synthetic botanical form
object_families.function_requirement: state one sensing, filtering, storing, growing, or protective function before rendering
identity_anchors: one organic contour
one seam, vein, or cell boundary
one contained core
object_families.material: powdery translucent membrane, active-hue interior, one restrained structural edge
object_families.geometry: one contained seed, membrane, folded leaf-machine, or cellular specimen with a single core
object_families.lighting: soft interior diffusion with one thicker chromatic edge; no liquid-metal gloss
object_families.visual_behavior: organic but designed; use a single specimen rather than a decorative botanical pattern

object_families.name: Optical or navigation object
object_families.function_requirement: state one aiming, tracking, surveying, focusing, or navigation function before rendering
identity_anchors: one aperture
one directional axis
one mounting or protective shell
object_families.material: matte body with one translucent aperture; no hard-rim highlight or lens flare
object_families.geometry: one convex aperture, tapered tube, rounded marker, or inflated beacon housing aimed along a single direction
object_families.lighting: diffuse directional shading with a contained aperture glow; no lens flare, orbit, or planet cue
object_families.visual_behavior: point or aim one rounded, optically exaggerated object toward a title axis without creating orbit language or a contemporary camera advertisement

object_families.name: Future mobility pod
object_families.function_requirement: state one personal transit, shared urban mobility, air travel, ground gliding, or short-range exploration function before rendering
identity_anchors: one dominant bubble canopy or convex cockpit portal
one swelling nose flowing into a tapered tail or compact spherical shell
one integrated keel, runner, shrouded wheel, or concealed propulsion support
one warm interior, docking seam, fin, lamp, or trim detail that follows the body curvature
object_families.material: optimistic colored enamel or molded fiberglass, clear or softly tinted bubble glass, restrained warm chrome or brushed-metal trim, and optional cream or caramel upholstery
object_families.geometry: invent the vehicle from a sphere, ovoid, water droplet, seed, or airfoil; use one continuous convex body, an oversized canopy, and subordinate integrated running gear rather than hood-cabin-trunk proportions
object_families.lighting: soft daylight or broad editorial studio light with generous tonal rolloff; glass and trim may sparkle gently but never become a modern automotive hero light
object_families.scale: use the selected scale role from 18% specimen anchor to 120% monumental fragment
title_relationships: title follows the canopy or tapered tail contour
vehicle points along the title axis
headline occupies open air above the body
one crop turns the canopy into a counter-shape
object_families.visual_behavior: derive the whole silhouette from bubble, droplet, seed, or airfoil geometry. Exaggerate canopy volume, nose curvature, or tail taper. It must not read as a current sedan, EV, sports car, or autonomous taxi with cosmetic rounding.

object_families.name: Future habitat capsule
object_families.function_requirement: state one resting, observing, sheltering, meeting, docking, or short-stay habitation function before rendering
identity_anchors: one inhabitable spherical, egg, or inflated shell
one large convex glass canopy or deep rounded portal
one integrated seat, cradle, plinth, docking band, or suspension point
one seam or trim ring explaining entry or connection
object_families.material: colored fiberglass or creamy lacquer shell, clear or smoke-tinted bubble glass, restrained warm-metal ring, and soft upholstered interior when visible
object_families.geometry: one inhabitable bubble, egg, joined-lobe pod, or rounded vertical capsule with an opening large enough to imply occupation and one coherent support or docking system
object_families.lighting: soft environmental daylight or hazy editorial studio light; reveal glass curvature and interior warmth without cinematic spacecraft lighting
object_families.scale: use the selected scale role from 16% specimen anchor to 120% monumental fragment
placements: primary capsule with one or two much smaller same-family satellites
title_relationships: support copy aligns to the docking seam
object_families.visual_behavior: make inhabitation legible through scale, canopy, seat, cradle, or docking logic while keeping the outer form rounded, optimistic, and unusually generous

object_families.name: Archive computing device
identity_anchors: period-correct monitor or terminal silhouette
keyboard, drive, cable, or pointing-device relationship
aged plastic, glass screen, and dark interface separation
one authentic port, slot, key field, or chassis seam
object_families.material: retain aged beige or gray plastic, glass screen, rubber cable, metal recesses, and period wear; allow only environmental tint or global print grading
object_families.geometry: one historically plausible computing setup or a decisive fragment with correct proportions between screen, chassis, keyboard, drive, and cable
object_families.lighting: archival product photography, broad side light, or environmental glow that preserves screen and casing separation
object_families.scale: use the selected scale role from 12% specimen anchor to 120% monumental fragment
placements: large right or left architectural crop
small grounded horizon or corner anchor
title_relationships: title overlays a protected empty casing field
object frames the title without covering critical controls
screen and title remain separate information tiers
object_families.visual_behavior: treat the computer as historical evidence; preserve proportions, plastic color, screen, keyboard, drive, and cable cues instead of redesigning it as a ceramic future device
object_families.screen_instance_rule: For SINGLE_OBJECT, COMPOUND_SET, or PRIMARY_SATELLITES, activate only the principal monitor. For REPEATED_FAMILY, only the largest or compositionally primary monitor may use SIGNAL or CARRIER; every subordinate monitor remains DORMANT.

object_families.name: Archive communication device
identity_anchors: period-correct handset, pager, or radio silhouette
dial, keypad, antenna, clip, or speaker field
aged plastic and rubber details
one authentic cable, display, or battery seam
object_families.material: retain aged molded plastic, rubber cable, printed key legends, small glass or LCD display, and restrained metal details
object_families.geometry: one recognizable communication device with historically coherent controls and proportions
object_families.lighting: flat archival advertisement light or soft environmental side light; no neon product rim
object_families.scale: use the selected scale role from 12% specimen anchor to 120% monumental fragment
title_relationships: title follows handset or antenna axis
small specimen closes the reading path
object_families.visual_behavior: preserve authentic controls and silhouette; use grain and global grading as the unifying layer

object_families.name: Archive media device
identity_anchors: period-correct screen, tape door, disc tray, or disk shell
recognizable transport controls, knobs, or meter field
stacked component proportions or one clear media slot
aged plastic, brushed metal, glass, and cable separation
object_families.material: retain real plastic, brushed metal, glass, printed controls, cassette windows, paper labels, and wear without inventing legible copy
object_families.geometry: one coherent media component, media stack, or object-plus-medium relationship with historically plausible proportions
object_families.lighting: warm catalog light, flat print-ad lighting, or softly graded archival photography
object_families.scale: use the selected scale role from 12% specimen anchor to 120% monumental fragment
title_relationships: headline overlaps only a quiet chassis area
rainbow or rule bridges title and device
footer aligns to the product base
object_families.visual_behavior: treat controls and media slots as material evidence, not decorative interface noise

object_families.name: Archive mobility object
identity_anchors: period-correct body silhouette and stance
recognizable lamp, grille, window, or wheel proportions
paint, glass, rubber, and chrome or trim separation
one historically plausible cabin or utility detail
object_families.material: retain painted metal, glass, rubber, upholstery, and restrained period trim; environmental grade may unify but must not turn the vehicle into a concept-car render
object_families.geometry: one complete side or three-quarter vehicle, or one decisive cropped body fragment with clear period proportions
object_families.lighting: soft daylight, catalog studio light, or global poster grade without cinematic neon
object_families.scale: use the selected scale role from 18% specimen anchor to 120% monumental fragment
title_relationships: headline occupies sky or body counter-space
object_families.visual_behavior: preserve period silhouette and practical stance; avoid futuristic redesign

object_families.name: Archive space object
identity_anchors: period-correct bus, capsule, dish, or instrument silhouette
solar panel, antenna, mast, thermal blanket, or structural truss
recognizable mounting and orientation logic
distinct metal, painted panel, fabric, and glass or sensor materials
object_families.material: retain real aerospace metal, painted panels, mesh dish, thermal blanket, wiring, and optical components; no generic chrome spaceship finish
object_families.geometry: one historically plausible satellite, probe, capsule fragment, or tracking instrument with correct structural relationships
object_families.lighting: archival documentation light, broad atmospheric grading, or print-ad treatment; avoid black cinematic space unless carrier and palette explicitly support it
object_families.scale: use the selected scale role from 16% specimen anchor to 120% monumental fragment
placements: diagonal object aligned to one signal axis
title_relationships: antenna or mast directs toward title
title occupies open field opposite the object
object_families.visual_behavior: use archival aerospace specificity rather than a generic spacecraft silhouette
